diagnostic_bottleneck: None. The presence of amber/yellow-brown viscous exudate (honeydew) on the panicle is a strong identity-defining feature for Ergot in its early stage, and explicitly contradicts Smut, Blast, Rust, Leaf Spots, and Downy Mildew.

final_decision.reason: The observed phenotype features amber/yellow-brown sticky exudate (honeydew) oozing from florets on the panicle. This matches the 'identity_defining' feature 'sticky_honeydew_when_present' for Ergot. It explicitly contradicts the 'contradiction' features for Smut (viscous_exudate), Blast (honeydew), Downy Mildew (honeydew), Rust (honeydew), and Leaf Spots (honeydew). The location (panicle/floret) and texture (viscous/sticky) strongly support Ergot.

symptom_class.description: Viscous, amber-colored fluid oozing from the florets and forming droplets.

geometry.structure_shape: Panicle retains cylindrical form; individual florets appear slightly swollen or distorted by exudate.

surface.features: Droplets of fluid visible on the surface of the panicle and hanging from the base.

distribution.pattern: Diffuse across the visible panicle head

reproductive_structure.transformation: No transformation to leafy tissue observed.
